caveats: 50-concurrent eligibility and 8-hour idle/session policies not established.
Pack table skips 200–1999 machine-hour range; do not interpolate. Tax and network/storage prices not stated.

Unknowns remain null, not free. The IDE pay-as-you-go workspace is an ordinary self-serve instance (not flagged alt); re-verified 2026-09-28 at https://cloud.tencent.cn/document/product/1039/131894 (CNY 0.1-7/h, 1C2G-64C128G, billed on usage duration from account balance).
Worked example assumes resources are released between active windows unless a retained-instance scenario is explicitly discussed.
VAT basis: Unknown: reviewed pricing source does not explicitly establish VAT/tax inclusion.
Residency: Tencent account binding required; exact runtime/data region choice not verified.

Billing runs whenever an IDE-mode tab (/a/{appid}/edit or /learn) is open, even with no process running and even if the tab is minimized; after all tabs are closed the machine is released only after ~10 min (billed). Default auto-shutdown timer is 1 h, max 24 h.

Overage is on by default: when a pack runs out the app is NOT stopped and usage switches to pay-as-you-go from the Tencent Cloud balance; when the account balance is insufficient the workspace is shut down early.
Using compute requires a bound Tencent Cloud account plus real-name (PRC ID) authentication; unverified accounts cannot use some compute.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: 超过 24 小时的连续运行，须在到期前重新进入空间续设时长，否则任务将随到期关机而中断。
snapshot_auto.note: Translation: 'continuous runs over 24 h must renew the timer before expiry, otherwise the task is interrupted by the shutdown.' Auto-shutdown (default 1 h, max 24 h) and closing all IDE tabs (released after ~10 min) stop the workspace and kill running processes; only the disk persists: API intro says '工作空间休眠或关闭后仍保留存储资源，删除后才会释放' (storage kept after sleep/stop until deletion, https://cloud.tencent.com/document/api/1039/94098). That is persistent_disk, not a snapshot; no memory checkpoint documented. Old-version free high-performance (GPU/HAI) workspaces idle >30 days after last shutdown are released and data destroyed (https://cloud.tencent.cn/document/product/1039/118036); old-version workspaces with no activity for 6 months may be purged.

harness_api.quote: 您可以调用 API 对 Cloud Studio 的工作空间进行管理，例如创建、修改、停止或查询工作空间等。
harness_api.note: Translation: 'You can use the API to manage Cloud Studio workspaces, e.g. create, modify, stop or query them.' The API overview (94107) lists only 9 workspace-management actions; nothing starts/streams an agent. CodeBuddy (IDE plugin, Craft agent) and CodeBuddy Code CLI ('codebuddy -p', '-c', '-r <session>') are preinstalled inside the workspace (500 credits/month), usable only from the in-browser IDE/terminal; that is agent_harnesses, not a harness API. CreateWorkspace Lifecycle init/start/destroy shell hooks are generic commands.

ingress_rules.quote:
四、端口访问权限设置​
你可以切换端口链接的可访问范围：
公开（默认）：链接可被外部访问（需服务已启动），适合对外展示。
仅自己可见：仅当前账号可访问（需服务已启动），适合隐私场景。
ingress_rules.note: Translation: 'Port access permission: Public (default) - link reachable externally; Only me - only the current account can access.' Per-port toggle on the HTTPS preview URL https://{spacekey}--{port}.{region}.cloudstudio.club. HTTP/WebSocket only; TCP/UDP forwarding and SSH not supported. App-level sharing: collaborators-only vs everyone links; CreateWorkspaceToken API issues temporary workspace tokens with policy workspace-run-only or all. No IP allowlist.

secret_proxy.quote: 环境变量. 会被注入到工作空间中
secret_proxy.note: Translation: 'Environment variables, injected into the workspace' (CreateWorkspace Envs). Secrets are plain env vars; the data-migration guide has users put COS SecretId/SecretKey directly into coscmd config inside the workspace. No credential-injecting proxy documented; no non-HTTP coverage.

isolation.quote: Docker 不支持或限制较多 (老版本) / 内置 Docker，更适合一键启动项目 (新版本)
isolation.note: Cloud Studio workspaces are multi-tenant browser IDE containers with built-in Docker-inside support (docker_inside=true already established). No mention of dedicated per-workspace VMs/hypervisors; consistent with the card's existing top-level isolation value.

image_oci.quote: DescribeImages 获取基础镜像列表
image_oci.note: The workspace-management API only exposes a 'list of base images' to pick from (predefined templates/environments); no documented API or UI path to boot a workspace from an arbitrary user-supplied Docker/OCI image.

nested_virt.quote: 内置 Docker，更适合一键启动项目
nested_virt.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a browser IDE container product; no /dev/kvm or nested-VM capability documented, only Docker-inside for containers.

desktop.quote: Cloud Studio（云端 IDE）是腾讯云提供的一款基于浏览器的集成式开发环境（IDE）
desktop.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a browser-based code IDE, not a graphical desktop/VNC/RDP product.

browser.quote: Web 预览用于在工作空间内快速查看页面效果。
browser.note: The 'Web 预览' port plugin is an in-IDE iframe preview of an app's own HTTP port, not a general-purpose managed/automatable browser inside the sandbox. not offered: outside the product's scope.

computer_use.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a code editor/IDE product, no screenshot+click desktop-driving API.

egress_ip_type.quote: Cloud Studio（云端 IDE）是腾讯云提供的一款基于浏览器的集成式开发环境（IDE），支持无需本地安装即可通过浏览器在线编程。
egress_ip_type.note: Workspaces run on Tencent Cloud's own datacenter infrastructure (mainland China/Asia); no residential/mobile proxy or dedicated static IP product documented. Ordinary shared datacenter egress.

snapshot.quote: 工作空间休眠或关闭后仍保留存储资源，删除后才会释放。
snapshot.note: Only the disk/storage persists across stop/sleep (persistent_disk=true); no memory checkpoint or explicit filesystem-snapshot object/API is documented anywhere in the workspace lifecycle or API docs.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: DescribeWorkspaces CreateWorkspace ModifyWorkspace RunWorkspace CreateWorkspaceToken StopWorkspace RemoveWorkspace DescribeImages
snapshot_on_demand.note: The full workspace API surface has no snapshot/checkpoint action; consistent with snapshot=none.

fork_running.quote: 支持更完善的协作、分享与复刻能力
fork_running.note: No documentation describes forking a currently-running workspace without stopping it; the '复刻' feature reads as app/template duplication, not a live clone operation.

memory_snapshot_fork.quote: 工作空间休眠或关闭后仍保留存储资源，删除后才会释放。
memory_snapshot_fork.note: No memory-state snapshot exists at all (snapshot=none), so a memory-preserving fork is not possible.

pause_resume.quote: StopWorkspace 停止运行空间 / RunWorkspace 运行空间
pause_resume.note: Workspaces can be stopped (StopWorkspace) and later run again (RunWorkspace); machine-hour billing only accrues while the workspace is in IDE mode, and storage is retained while stopped, i.e. billing is paused/reduced while stopped.

wake_on_request.quote: 进入以下页面即开始消耗（即使没有运行/调试进程，也会占用算力）：https://cloudstudio.net/a/{appid}/edit
wake_on_request.note: Simply navigating to a workspace's edit/learn URL starts consuming compute time, implying the workspace is started/woken automatically on that request rather than requiring a separate explicit start call.

volume_attach.quote: 工作空间：一个包含独立存储、计算资源与开发环境的虚拟单元
volume_attach.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — each workspace has one bundled storage unit; no separate attachable/detachable volume resource or API is documented.

volume_shared.quote: 工作空间：一个包含独立存储、计算资源与开发环境的虚拟单元，用于隔离不同项目或团队成员。
volume_shared.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — storage is described as isolated per workspace; no shared-volume-across-machines capability documented.

live_resize.quote: 算力切换 - 在工作空间中切换 CPU / GPU 算力的操作步骤与注意事项。
live_resize.note: The '算力切换' (compute switch) feature lets users switch CPU/GPU spec from within a running workspace's editor UI, i.e. without recreating the workspace.

own_agent_api.quote: 集成 GPU 算力、AI 代码助手、实时协作及云原生部署能力
own_agent_api.note: The bundled 'AI 代码助手' (CodeBuddy) is a coding agent/harness inside the IDE, not a first-party API driving the provider's own browser/computer-use/research task agent. not offered: outside the product's scope.

mcp_server.quote: DescribeWorkspaces CreateWorkspace ModifyWorkspace RunWorkspace CreateWorkspaceToken StopWorkspace RemoveWorkspace DescribeImages
mcp_server.note: No MCP server for controlling Cloud Studio workspaces is listed in the API docs; the CodeBuddy IDE assistant may itself consume MCP servers as a client, but that's not the provider shipping an MCP server to control its sandboxes.

egress_allowlist.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no egress allow/deny-list, security-group, or no-internet-mode control is documented for workspaces.
